regions.label: ObjectLookupConstants

regions.label: ObjectParameterTables
regions.evidence: Repeated flags and smooth coordinate constants. $98C6 consumed at $8E01, mission-indexed $98D2/$98DC/$98E6 consumed at $F376/$F30E/$F304. Full boundaries and non-code patterns inspected. See final_data.py, unknown-listing.txt and static-listing.txt.

regions.label: PaletteData

Full interval lies between graphics routines; supported generic graphics data, precise palette selection unresolved. See final_data.py, unknown-listing.txt and static-listing.txt.

regions.label: SoundModulationHandlers
regions.evidence: Seven little-endian handler pointers at $A57D: $A544,$A58E,$A5C1,$A5BD,$A58B,$A5B8,$A607, consumed through sound dispatch $A57A. Static pointer data, not pointer values alone proving target code. A58B/A58E overlapping entry interpretation documented separately. See final_data.py, unknown-listing.txt and static-listing.txt.

regions.label: SoundDutyMasks
regions.evidence: Eight explicit duty-mask constants $80,$C0,$40,$00,$40,$80,$C0,$00 indexed from $A5A3 after AND7. Exact selected domain and code-delimited extent coincide. See final_data.py, unknown-listing.txt and static-listing.txt.

regions.label: SoundVolumeDeltas
regions.evidence: Eight 01/00 delta values addressed by $A61D after AND7. Independently bounded eight-byte domain and next code entry. See final_data.py, unknown-listing.txt and static-listing.txt.

regions.label: SoundEffectDescriptors
regions.evidence: Twelve complete eight-byte records bounded by $B0AC and next accepted handler $B10C. AF7E applies first four APU register bytes; AF16 reads final callback word at record+6; middle fields used by AF41/AF69. All record callback contracts checked. Specific structural record domain, natural use of every record unresolved. See final_data.py, unknown-listing.txt and static-listing.txt.

regions.label: GameplayLookupConstants

regions.label: ResultAnimationCommands
